mapper.insert: insert into t_capp_ai_memory_state(user_id) values(#{userId}) on duplicate key update user_id=user_id
mapper.select: select enabled,revision,forget_before_id as fence from t_capp_ai_memory_state where user_id=#{userId}
select enabled,revision,forget_before_id as fence from t_capp_ai_memory_state where user_id=#{userId} for update
select memory_key as memoryKey,memory_value as `value` from t_capp_ai_memory where user_id=#{userId} order by memory_key
mapper.insert: insert into t_capp_ai_memory(user_id,memory_key,memory_value,updated_at) values(#{userId},#{key},#{value},current_timestamp(3)) on duplicate key update memory_value=#{value},updated_at=current_timestamp(3)
mapper.delete: delete from t_capp_ai_memory where user_id=#{userId} and memory_key=#{key}
mapper.select: select count(*) from t_capp_ai_run where user_id=#{userId} and status='RUNNING'
select coalesce(max(m.id),0) from t_capp_ai_message m join t_capp_ai_session s on s.id=m.session_id where s.user_id=#{userId}
select content,through_id as throughId,revision from t_capp_ai_summary where user_id=#{userId} and session_id=#{sessionId}

select m.id,m.role,m.content from t_capp_ai_message m join t_capp_ai_session s on s.id=m.session_id join t_capp_ai_run r on r.id=m.run_id where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.id=#{sessionId} and r.status='COMPLETED' and m.id > #{after} and m.id < #{before} order by m.id limit 24
mapper.insert: insert into t_capp_ai_summary(session_id,user_id,content,through_id,revision,updated_at) select id,user_id,#{content},#{through},#{revision},current_timestamp(3) from t_capp_ai_session where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} on duplicate key update content=#{content},through_id=#{through},revision=#{revision},updated_at=current_timestamp(3)
mapper.select: select run_id as runId,user_id as userId,session_id as sessionId,attempts from t_capp_ai_memory_extract_job where (status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at<=current_timestamp(3)) or (status='PROCESSING' and lease_until<current_timestamp(3)) order by created_at limit 1
mapper.update: update t_capp_ai_memory_extract_job set status='PROCESSING',attempts=attempts+1, lease_until=date_add(current_timestamp(3),interval 2 minute),updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where run_id=#{runId} and ((status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at<=current_timestamp(3)) or (status='PROCESSING' and lease_until<current_timestamp(3)))
mapper.select: select m.id as messageId,m.content,r.id as runId,r.session_id as sessionId from t_capp_ai_message m join t_capp_ai_run r on r.id=m.run_id join t_capp_ai_session s on s.id=r.session_id and s.user_id=r.user_id join t_capp_ai_memory_state ms on ms.user_id=r.user_id and ms.enabled=1 where r.id=#{runId} and r.user_id=#{userId} and r.status='COMPLETED' and m.role='user' and m.id > ms.forget_before_id

select id,user_id as userId,memory_type as memoryType,content,content_hash as contentHash, status,revision,updated_at as updatedAt from t_capp_ai_memory_item where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE'
select id,revision from t_capp_ai_memory_item where user_id=#{userId} and content_hash=#{contentHash} and status='ACTIVE' order by updated_at desc limit 1
mapper.update: update t_capp_ai_memory_item set status='SUPERSEDED',superseded_by=#{replacementId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE'
update t_capp_ai_memory_item set content=#{content},content_hash=#{contentHash},revision=revision+1,updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE'
update t_capp_ai_memory_item set status='DELETED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select id,memory_id as memoryId,user_id as userId,revision,operation,attempts from t_capp_ai_memory_vector_outbox where (status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at<=current_timestamp(3)) or (status='PROCESSING' and lease_until<current_timestamp(3)) order by id limit 1
mapper.update: update t_capp_ai_memory_vector_outbox set status='PROCESSING',attempts=attempts+1, lease_until=date_add(current_timestamp(3),interval 2 minute),updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and ((status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at<=current_timestamp(3)) or (status='PROCESSING' and lease_until<current_timestamp(3)))
mapper.select: select id,user_id as userId,memory_type as memoryType,content,status,revision from t_capp_ai_memory_item where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
